intro.desktop: Ownership is more than possession. It shapes identity, responsibility, freedom and the relationship between people and the things they create, exchange, protect and value.

descriptionLeft.desktop: Ownership is the first theme of UNBLOCKED, inviting artists, designers and creative thinkers to explore one of the most enduring ideas in human society. It reaches beyond property and assets into money, labour and exchange: how value is created, who gets to hold it, and how ownership shapes autonomy, access and power.

descriptionRight.desktop: This open call encourages participants to move beyond conventional definitions and examine ownership through cultural, emotional, economic, philosophical and creative perspectives.
